jobs.title: Executive Director
jobs.description:
About Us:

Southside Coalition of Community Health Centers (Southside Coalition) brings together community health organizations and partners committed to improving access to care and advancing the health of underserved communities in South Los Angeles. Through collaboration, community-based programs, care coordination, and shared learning, Southside Coalition works to strengthen connections across the healthcare system and improve outcomes for the communities its members serve.

Website:
https://southsidecoalition.org/

Job Summary:

Southside Coalition is seeking a hands-on, mission-driven Executive Director to lead the organization. Reporting to the Board of Directors, the Executive Director will have overall responsibility for Southside Coalition's operations, staff, grant portfolio, partnerships, and strategic direction. 

This is a unique opportunity for a leader who can balance hands-on execution with strategic, big-picture thinking to advance the organization’s mission. In the near term, the Executive Director will focus on strengthening day-to-day operations, developing sustainable processes and infrastructure, supporting and developing staff, and ensuring successful execution of existing grant commitments. Over time, the role will increasingly focus on organizational growth, funder relationships, new funding opportunities, advocacy, and expanding the value Southside Coalition provides to its member health centers and the communities they serve. 

The ideal candidate is a highly independent and resourceful leader who can move seamlessly between managing operational details and representing Southside Coalition externally. They will bring strong relationship-building skills, a deep commitment to underserved communities, and the ability to create structure while identifying opportunities for the organization's future. 

This position is based in Los Angeles and will initially work fully onsite alongside Southside Coalition's team. Hybrid flexibility may be considered after approximately six months based on organizational needs and performance.

Core Responsibilities:

Organizational Leadership & Operations 

Provide overall strategic leadership and day-to-day management of Southside Coalition, translating priorities into effective organizational operations. 
Strengthen organizational infrastructure by developing and documenting policies, procedures, workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 
Oversee core administrative functions, including payroll, timekeeping, employee reimbursements, vendor relationships, invoices, payments, and other organizational operations. 
Serve as the primary organizational contact for external accounting, IT, and other vendors. 
Identify opportunities to improve organizational systems, processes, and operational effectiveness. 
Balance immediate operational needs with longer-term strategic priorities and organizational growth. 

Staff Leadership & Development 

Lead, coach, and develop a team of six Patient Navigators and one Outreach Coordinator. 
Establish clear expectations, accountability, and decision-making structures that enable staff to work with increasing independence. 
Foster an engaged, collaborative, and mission-driven team culture. 
Provide hands-on guidance and problem-solving support while building the team's capabilities over time. 

Grants, Funding & Organizational Development 

Oversee Southside Coalition's portfolio of grant-funded programs, ensuring compliance with funder requirements, timely deliverables, and effective program execution. 
Maintain strong relationships with existing funders and serve as a trusted representative of the organization. 
Identify, evaluate, and pursue grant and other funding opportunities aligned with Southside Coalition's mission and strategic priorities. 
Support the long-term diversification and growth of organizational funding. 
Partner with the Board to identify opportunities for organizational development and expansion. 

Board, Coalition & External Relations 

Serve as the primary liaison to the Board of Directors and work closely with Board Officers to advance organizational priorities. 
Plan and facilitate Board and coalition meetings, including developing agendas, coordinating content, and documenting key decisions and next steps. 
Build and maintain strong relationships with coalition members, health centers, hospitals, funders, community organizations, and other external stakeholders. 
Oversee patient discharge and care coordination efforts, partnering with hospital providers, health centers, IPAs, and other community-based providers to support effective patient transitions, continuity of care, and timely information-sharing. 
Ensure monthly coalition meetings provide meaningful value to members through relevant speakers, resources, best-practice sharing, partnership opportunities, and peer learning. 
Identify opportunities to strengthen collaboration and information-sharing between hospitals, health centers, and other community partners. 
Represent Southside Coalition at community meetings, events, and other external forums. 
Serve as an advocate for Southside Coalition, its member health centers, and the underserved communities they serve.

Position Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an entrepreneurial and highly resourceful leader who thrives in a small organization making meaningful impact. They are comfortable operating independently, taking initiative, and stepping in wherever needed while maintaining a clear view of the organization's larger mission and future. 

Required qualifications

Demonstrated experience in grant administration, including grant deliverables, compliance, and reporting. 
Experience leading, supervising, and developing staff. 
Experience with payroll and day-to-day organizational or administrative operations. 
Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. 
Exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building skills. 
Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, and public speaking skills. 
Demonstrated commitment to serving underserved communities. 

Preferred qualifications

Experience within Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), healthcare, managed care, community-based organizations, or a related environment. 
Experience working with community partners, funders, healthcare organizations, and other external stakeholders. 
Knowledge of the Los Angeles healthcare and community landscape and the populations served by Southside Coalition. 
Experience with fundraising, organizational development, grant prospecting, or partnership development. 
Experience working with or reporting to a nonprofit Board of Directors.

Direct Reports:

Patient Navigators (6)
Outreach Coordinator

Compensation Range:
$127,500-$172,500 annually, depending on qualifications and experience.

Our company is on a mission to reduce food waste and make high-quality, affordable food accessible to everyone. Through our innovative app-based marketplace, we connect shoppers with discounted perishable items while helping retailers turn would-be waste into revenue and meaningful environmental impact. We're growing quickly across North America and partnering with retailers of all sizes to expand our reach.

If you're passionate about creating real change for people and the planet, we'd love for you to join us. Your work here will directly contribute to a mission that helps families save money, reduces waste, and builds a more sustainable future.

We're looking for a Director of Communications
to help shape the brand of Flashfood in the world, by telling stories about our business, our technology, our environmental impact and the shoppers and retail partners who love us.

The goal of our Communications function is to raise awareness, drive adoption (for both shoppers and retailers), build trust and loyalty, and increase brand love and affinity.

This dynamic leader will be highly strategic in their approach, inherently collaborative with other internal teams, and deeply curious about all the aspects of the business, our industry and the key stakeholders who are most important to its success. This person is a proactive, forward-thinking professional who can see around corners, and knows how to position the brand in the right way, at the right time, with the right people.

This role is ideal for someone who:

Thrives in a constantly evolving environment (in a good way, we're growing fast!)
Thinks strategically across both sides of our marketplace, shopper and retailer, and builds cohesive stories that inform, attract, and create lasting affinity for each
Communicates brilliantly, whether in writing, in a room, or through visuals
Takes ownership and drives ideas all the way through execution
Builds strong relationships inside and outside the company, and knows how to activate them for mutual benefit
Balances speed with quality, and short-term wins with long-term thinking
Is driven by solving real business problems with measurable impact

Drive the external narrative and overall perception of Flashfood, using outside storytellers (press, creators/influencers, podcasts, etc.) and partners (NGOs, etc.) as your canvas
Lead Media Relations, Creator Relations, Government Affairs/NGO Outreach, Industry Relations, Internal Comms, and Social Impact for Flashfood
Partner with Marketing to produce campaigns that showcase the brand's impact, and turn our announcements and activity into storytelling opportunities
Partner with teams across the company (e.g. Product) to mine for storytelling opportunities that drive the business forward
Create and execute an executive visibility strategy, platforming our key execs in press, industry events, and beyond
Develop an ongoing slate of consumer PR stories that keep Flashfood topical among our KOLs, and broaden the range of media that covers us
Build a cohesive Creator Relations strategy, partnering with third-party creators and influencers to tell brand stories that bring in new audiences and retain current ones
Build and nurture relationships with press — both traditional media (print, broadcast, .com) and "new media" (podcasts, Substacks, etc.) — to land stories that advance the brand
Lead our relationships with relevant government entities and NGOs, partnering with them to elevate the Flashfood brand and the impact we're having on food waste reduction
Partner with People on our internal comms strategy and approach
Lead the assembly and dissemination of the annual Impact Report
Partner with our PR agency, briefing and guiding them with efficiency and impact

What You'll Bring

A deep expertise shaping corporate narratives for high-growth companies, ideally within consumer, tech, or marketplace driven industries
At least 8 years experience in a cross section of the following categories: Media Relations, Executive Visibility, Creator Relations, Government Affairs, Internal Comms and Social Impact
Strong earned media experience, with an impressive track record of landing stories in a variety of media outlets
Extensive experience working across earned media, influencer, editorial, and event-driven communications
Strong judgment when it comes to decision making around high-stakes external activity
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity
Proven ability to execute and deliver results in a fast-paced environment
Effective communication and collaboration skills
A high level of ownership and accountability
Comfort working cross-functionally and balancing competing priorities
Data-driven mindset, with the ability to define success, measure performance, and adjust based on impact

Experience in product communications
Experience working across both the US and Canadian markets
Experience working with or for a two-sided marketplace
Experience leveraging AI tools and strategies to boost performance

100% remote work with flexibility and trust
Mission-driven work that reduces food waste and expands access to affordable food
A fast-growing, collaborative team with big ambitions
Real opportunities for career growth

Website:
https://southsidecoalition.org/

Job Summary:

Southside Coalition is seeking a hands-on, mission-driven Executive Director to lead the organization. Reporting to the Board of Directors, the Executive Director will have overall responsibility for Southside Coalition's operations, staff, grant portfolio, partnerships, and strategic direction. 

This is a unique opportunity for a leader who can balance hands-on execution with strategic, big-picture thinking to advance the organization’s mission. In the near term, the Executive Director will focus on strengthening day-to-day operations, developing sustainable processes and infrastructure, supporting and developing staff, and ensuring successful execution of existing grant commitments. The ideal candidate is a highly independent and resourceful leader who can move seamlessly between managing operational details and representing Southside Coalition externally. This position is based in Los Angeles and will initially work fully onsite alongside Southside Coalition's team. Hybrid flexibility may be considered after approximately six months based on organizational needs and performance.

Partner with the Board to identify opportunities for organizational development and expansion.

About Us

Our company is on a mission to reduce food waste and make high-quality, affordable food accessible to everyone. Through our innovative app-based marketplace, we connect shoppers with discounted perishable items while helping retailers turn would-be waste into revenue and meaningful environmental impact. We're growing quickly across North America and partnering with retailers of all sizes to expand our reach.

If you're passionate about creating real change for people and the planet, we'd love for you to join us. Your work here will directly contribute to a mission that helps families save money, reduces waste, and builds a more sustainable future.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Director of Communications
to help shape the brand of Flashfood in the world, by telling stories about our business, our technology, our environmental impact and the shoppers and retail partners who love us.

The goal of our Communications function is to raise awareness, drive adoption (for both shoppers and retailers), build trust and loyalty, and increase brand love and affinity.

This dynamic leader will be highly strategic in their approach, inherently collaborative with other internal teams, and deeply curious about all the aspects of the business, our industry and the key stakeholders who are most important to its success. This person is a proactive, forward-thinking professional who can see around corners, and knows how to position the brand in the right way, at the right time, with the right people.

This role is ideal for someone who:

Thrives in a constantly evolving environment (in a good way, we're growing fast!)
Thinks strategically across both sides of our marketplace, shopper and retailer, and builds cohesive stories that inform, attract, and create lasting affinity for each
Communicates brilliantly, whether in writing, in a room, or through visuals
Takes ownership and drives ideas all the way through execution
Builds strong relationships inside and outside the company, and knows how to activate them for mutual benefit
Balances speed with quality, and short-term wins with long-term thinking
Is driven by solving real business problems with measurable impact

What You'll Do

Drive the external narrative and overall perception of Flashfood, using outside storytellers (press, creators/influencers, podcasts, etc.) and partners (NGOs, etc.) as your canvas
Lead Media Relations, Creator Relations, Government Affairs/NGO Outreach, Industry Relations, Internal Comms, and Social Impact for Flashfood
Partner with Marketing to produce campaigns that showcase the brand's impact, and turn our announcements and activity into storytelling opportunities
Partner with teams across the company (e.g. Product) to mine for storytelling opportunities that drive the business forward
Create and execute an executive visibility strategy, platforming our key execs in press, industry events, and beyond
Develop an ongoing slate of consumer PR stories that keep Flashfood topical among our KOLs, and broaden the range of media that covers us
Build a cohesive Creator Relations strategy, partnering with third-party creators and influencers to tell brand stories that bring in new audiences and retain current ones
Build and nurture relationships with press — both traditional media (print, broadcast, .com) and "new media" (podcasts, Substacks, etc.) — to land stories that advance the brand
Lead our relationships with relevant government entities and NGOs, partnering with them to elevate the Flashfood brand and the impact we're having on food waste reduction
Partner with People on our internal comms strategy and approach
Lead the assembly and dissemination of the annual Impact Report
Partner with our PR agency, briefing and guiding them with efficiency and impact

What You'll Bring

A deep expertise shaping corporate narratives for high-growth companies, ideally within consumer, tech, or marketplace driven industries
At least 8 years experience in a cross section of the following categories: Media Relations, Executive Visibility, Creator Relations, Government Affairs, Internal Comms and Social Impact
Strong earned media experience, with an impressive track record of landing stories in a variety of media outlets
Extensive experience working across earned media, influencer, editorial, and event-driven communications
Strong judgment when it comes to decision making around high-stakes external activity
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity
Proven ability to execute and deliver results in a fast-paced environment
Effective communication and collaboration skills
A high level of ownership and accountability
Comfort working cross-functionally and balancing competing priorities
Data-driven mindset, with the ability to define success, measure performance, and adjust based on impact

Nice to Have

Experience in product communications
Experience working across both the US and Canadian markets
Experience working with or for a two-sided marketplace
Experience leveraging AI tools and strategies to boost performance

What We Offer

Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits
100% remote work with flexibility and trust
Mission-driven work that reduces food waste and expands access to affordable food
A fast-growing, collaborative team with big ambitions
Real opportunities for career growth
